onNodeDoubleClick.label: On Node Double Click
onNodeDoubleClick.description: On node double-click (e.g. to drill in)

repulsion.label: Repulsion
repulsion.description: Force-sim repulsion strength between nodes (larger ⇒ more spread out)

onBadgeClick.label: On Badge Click
onBadgeClick.description: On node badge click (e.g. to expand a merged cluster).

onMarkClick.label: On Mark Click
onMarkClick.description: On marked-node click (suggestion/proposal target). Takes priority over onNodeClick.

linkOpacity.label: Link Opacity
linkOpacity.description: Base opacity for links when nothing is hovered (kept faint so dense graphs stay readable; incident links brighten on hover).

nodeSpacing.label: Node Spacing
nodeSpacing.description: Minimum empty gap (px) enforced between node edges so nodes never overlap.

similarity.label: Similarity
similarity.description: All-pairs similarity (cosine 0–1) used ONLY for layout, never drawn. It is the secondary macro-layout: non-connected pairs get a weak spring (higher cosine ⇒ closer) so clusters arrange relative to each other; drawn `edges` stay the primary tight structure. When omitted, edges alone drive the layout.

linkDistance.label: Link Distance
linkDistance.description: Force-sim target edge length (larger ⇒ more spread out)

proposedEdges.label: Proposed Edges
proposedEdges.description: Uncommitted proposal links — rendered dashed/faint in a separate pass, never folded into the layout springs.
